_setup_instructions: 1. Copy this file as profile.json (remove this _setup_instructions field)
2. Fill in all fields marked with YOUR_... or [...] placeholders
3. Remove all _comment fields from the final profile.json
OR run /setup profile to have Claude guide you through filling this interactively
name: YOUR_FULL_NAME
_comment_nationality: List all nationalities/work authorizations. e.g., ['US Citizen', 'EU Citizen']
_comment_years: Use exact phrasing you'll use in CVs. Always consistent.
_comment_summary: How you describe yourself in 2-3 sentences. Will be used as base for CV summaries.
_comment_skills: Only list skills you can defend in a technical interview. Remove anything you've only touched once.
_comment_learning: Skills you're actively building but cannot claim proficiency. Will be framed as 'building experience' in CVs.
_comment_experience: List all positions, most recent first. Bullets are the selection pool for CV adaptation — the more detail, the better.

projects.name: YOUR_PROJECT_NAME
projects.description: BRIEF_DESCRIPTION — what you built, with what tools, and what outcome.

_comment_projects: Include personal projects, academic capstones, side projects. Work projects go in experience, not here.

education._comment_degree: Use exact name as it appears on your diploma. Never abbreviate (e.g., NOT 'MBA' if it's 'Executive Master in Business Analytics')

preferences._comment_roles: Roles you're actively targeting. Used in pre-screening logic.
preferences._comment_industries: Preferred industries. Used in fit scoring bonuses. Use lowercase slugs.
preferences._comment_salary: Minimum acceptable salary as a number. Used in auto-skip logic.
preferences._comment_currency: Currency for salary comparisons. Use 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', etc.
preferences._comment_sponsorship: Set to true if you need visa sponsorship. Enables sponsorship check in job-analysis.
